title: Remote terminal preserves fast typing order
description: Use a private authenticated gateway, production remote node and owned private tmux socket. Compare actual remote stdin bytes for concurrent client requests and the Companion live input buffer. Never touch a product run or shared tmux server.

remote-fast-typing.intent: Burst fast keystrokes from two real clients and Companion batching into an owned remote terminal; compare exact stdin bytes and retain observed load and scoped teardown.
